home.teacherSubtitle: Organize your subjects and prepare the content your class will study.

home.fProgressDesc: Track your growth subject by subject.

chat.summaryInitial: Hi, I am Bob, Smart Study's study assistant. Send me a topic and I will summarize it. After the summary, you can ask me questions about it.
chat.quizzInitial: Hi, I am Bob, Smart Study's study assistant. I will build an 8-question quiz with several question types (multiple choice, fill in the blank, open answer, practical and real case) and grade each answer right away. Your progress is only saved if you answer them all, and the quiz adapts to what you miss the most. Which topic would you like to test? Send me the subject.
